title: 023 剥丹炼形024 师父又复活了
content_zh:
：李静虚在灵玉崖前跟华瑶崧的对话，管明晦“看”
得清清楚楚。
这方圆百里之内的花草树木都是他的“耳目”
，灵玉崖左近的被他洗炼次数最多，效力更强。
他躺在石床上一动不动，实际上在全神关注着外面的情况。
李静虚虽然道法高妙，但也没想到他能通过植物作为感知器官来观看聆听。
当然他也是没有把这妖尸太放在心上，以为其一举一动全在自己法眼观照之下，不想竟被反向窥视。
“真没想到，长眉真人用来禁锢谷辰的这些手段，如今反倒成了自己的保护屏障，只要自己不破坏掉长眉真人的预言，李静虚、华瑶崧，还有峨眉派的人应该都不会提前来对付自己。”
弄明白这点以后，管明晦感叹造化弄人。
从他穿越过来为节点，之前是谷辰的人生，之后是他自己的人生，两段人生相互连接相互影响，很多谷辰种下的因要他来受果。
可在这个大的因果框架之内，又会出现有趣的吉凶反转，原本是吉的，可能变成凶的，原本有害的，也有可能变成有利的。
天淫教主也有推算之法，只是以月相为尊，名为玄阴神数。
六十四卦，乾上坤下，为先天之数，离东坎西，为后天之数。
其余六十卦，每两卦对应一天的上下两弦，匹配月相。
从初一的朝屯暮蒙到三十的既济未济，轮转不休。
这既是玄阴丹法的修炼底层原理，也是玄阴神数的推算法则。
不过这门推算方法格局较小，只能推算小事，无法推算大事，小事十分精准，大事往往模糊不清。
而且更适合推算“阴事”
，不适合推算“阳事”
要想算得准，除了排盘布局，还得有丰富的阅历，才能拆解破局，算得真切，不然就算得出结果，也不知道卦象到底指向什么。

这东西非常讲求悟性，单有谷辰的千年记忆还不行，他得有自己的体悟。
李静虚的来去，无疑相当于让他在生死之间走了一遭，李静虚走后，他算是劫后重生，回过去头去按照玄阴卦象对照复盘，一下子有了许多新的领悟。
搞清楚自己当下的状况后，管明晦长长出了口气。
自从杀了陆敏，这几年间他每天都当作是末日在活，每时每刻都在提心吊胆，从此以后，是可以放松下来了。
三年多的时间里，他自己已经历了三次还丹。
所谓还丹，是跟炼丹相反的逆转过程。
【注】
前面的炼丹，是从身体上抽取精气神，凝炼内丹。
但仙道贵生，不似佛家那般，把身体当作“色身”
“臭皮囊”
，需要保养身体，长生不老。
因此再将内丹返还回来，洗炼全身。
这时候能让身体产生质的变化，齿落更生，白发转黑，耳聪目明，身体轻便……
content_en:
: Li Jingxu’s conversation with Hua Yaosong in front of Lingyu Cliff, Guan Minghui “watched”
Be clear.
All the flowers, plants and trees within a hundred miles are his "eyes and ears"
, the one near Lingyu Cliff has been refined by him the most times and is more effective.
He lay motionless on the stone bed, actually paying full attention to the situation outside.
Although Li Jingxu was a master of Taoism, he did not expect that he could see and listen through plants as sensory organs.
Of course, he didn't take this monster corpse too seriously, thinking that every move he made was under his own observation, and he didn't want to be watched from the opposite direction.
"I really didn't expect that the methods used by Master Changmei to imprison Gu Chen have now become my own protective barrier. As long as I don't destroy Master Changmei's prophecy, Li Jingxu, Hua Yaosong, and people from the Emei sect will probably not come to deal with me in advance."
After understanding this, Guan Minghui lamented that fate had played a trick on people.
From the time he traveled through time as the node, it was Gu Chen's life before, and his own life after that. The two lives were connected and influenced each other, and many of the causes planted by Gu Chen required him to bear the consequences.
But within this large causal framework, there will be interesting reversals of good and bad. What was originally good may become bad, and what was originally harmful may also become beneficial.
The leader of Tianyin also has a method of calculation, but he uses the moon phase as the most important method, which is called Xuanyin Divine Number.
The sixty-fourth hexagram, Qian above Kun below, is the innate number, and Li Dongkanxi is the acquired number.
For the remaining sixty hexagrams, every two hexagrams correspond to the upper and lower chords of the day, matching the moon phases.
From the twilight days in the first year of junior high school to the twilight days in the thirties, the cycle goes on and on.
This is not only the underlying principle of Xuanyin Dan method, but also the calculation principle of Xuanyin divine number.
However, this calculation method has a small structure and can only calculate small things, but cannot predict big things. Small things are very accurate, but big things are often vague.
And it is more suitable for calculating "underlying things"
, not suitable for calculating "yang events"
If you want to calculate accurately, you must not only arrange the layout, but also have rich experience in order to break down the situation and calculate accurately. Otherwise, even if you get the result, you still don’t know what the hexagram is pointing to.
This thing requires a lot of understanding. Gu Chen's thousand-year memory alone is not enough. He has to have his own understanding.
Li Jingxu's coming and going was undoubtedly equivalent to letting him walk between life and death. After Li Jingxu left, he was reborn after a disaster. He went back to compare and review according to the Xuanyin hexagram, and suddenly gained many new insights.
After figuring out his current situation, Guan Minghui let out a long sigh.
Since killing Lu Min, he has lived every day as if it was the end of the world in the past few years, and he has been on tenterhooks all the time. From now on, he can relax.
In more than three years, he himself has experienced three elixir returns.
The so-called returning elixir is the reverse process of refining elixir.
【Note】
The previous alchemy is to extract the essence, energy and spirit from the body to condense the inner elixir.
However, the noble life of immortality is not like that of Buddhism, which regards the body as a "material body"
"Small skin bag"
, need to maintain the body and live forever.
Therefore, return the inner elixir back to cleanse the whole body.
At this time, the body can undergo qualitative changes, the teeth will be regenerated, the white hair will turn black, the ears and eyes will be sharp, and the body will be light...
